Its desktop module format makes it perfect for studio integration and live performance, offering a comprehensive synthesis experience in a compact package.

Further enhancing its sonic palette, the Prophet Rev2 features waveshape modulation, allowing continuous alteration of any of the four waveforms (sawtooth, triangle, saw/triangle mix, and square wave). Each layer has its own dedicated effects processor, providing reverb, delay, chorus, phase shifter, and distortion. The intuitive interface and flexible architecture make it a powerful tool for sound designers and musicians alike, delivering a wide range of classic and contemporary sounds.

As Dave’s last keyboard design, the Rev2 sports more of everything that made the Prophet ’08 great: more polyphony, more effects, more modulation options, more memory, and more. The Rev2 sports two digitally controlled analog oscillators (DCOs) per voice. Oscillator A offers sawtooth, triangle, and pulse waves with pulse-width modulation. Oscillators can be hard-synced, and both oscillators can be detuned to add subtle warmth or create massive, complex sounds.

official_description:
The Prophet-6 is Dave Smith’s tribute to the poly synth that started it all—the Sequential Circuits Prophet-5. But it’s not simply a reissue. Rather, as Dave puts it, “It’s the result of our effort to build the most awesome-sounding analog poly synth possible.” The Prophet-6 takes the best qualities of the original Prophet-5—true voltage-controlled oscillators, filters, and amplifiers—and adds modern enhancements such as studio-quality effects, a polyphonic step sequencer, an arpeggiator, and more. 

Its all-analog signal path is driven by two discrete voltage-controlled oscillators plus a sub-oscillator per voice. The oscillators provide continuously variable waveshapes including sine, sawtooth, and pulse with variable pulse width. A classic four-pole resonant low-pass filter, inspired by the original Prophet-5 filter, adds warmth and presence. Voltage-controlled amplifiers complete the all-analog signal path. However, the Prophet-6 is far more than just a vintage replica. Modern features like velocity and aftertouch sensitivity increase its expressiveness and playability.

The Prophet Rev2 is Dave Smith's evolved version of the Prophet '08, offering more power and flexibility. It boasts 8 voices of polyphony, a waveshape modulation feature on each oscillator, digital effects per layer, a polyphonic step sequencer per layer, and more modulation options than the original. The Rev2 retains all the best qualities of its predecessor and expands upon them, making it a modern classic for sound designers and musicians alike.

Its expanded feature set includes dual digital effects (reverb, delay, chorus, phase shifter), a sub-octave generator per oscillator, a gated 16 x 4 step sequencer, and four freely assignable LFOs. The intuitive interface and comprehensive connectivity make it an ideal centerpiece for any studio or stage setup, allowing for deep exploration of sound design and expressive performance capabilities.

official_description:
The Sequential Prophet-5 Desktop Module brings back the classic analog polysynth loved by musicians worldwide. Featuring the same components as the Rev 4 keyboard version, including the genuine Curtis filters and Dave Rossum-designed SSI 2140 oscillators, it offers the authentic sound that made the Prophet-5 a legend. Its compact design makes it ideal for studio use and live performance where space is limited.

This module delivers the rich, warm, and powerful tones that defined a generation of music. With its faithful recreation of the original circuitry and intuitive controls, it's perfect for recreating classic sounds or forging new sonic territories. The Prophet-5 Desktop Module is an essential tool for any serious synth enthusiast or professional musician seeking the iconic Prophet-5 sound in a convenient package.

official_specs.Filter: 2-pole Oberheim SEM-type multimode filter per voice

official_description:
The Sequential OB-6 Desktop delivers the unmistakable sound of the Oberheim SEM in a space-saving module. Designed by Dave Smith and Tom Oberheim, it features discrete SEM-based oscillators and filters, providing the warmth and punch that defined a generation of synthesizers. Its hands-on interface allows for intuitive sound design, making it equally suited for recreating classic tones and crafting entirely new sounds. 

Equipped with a powerful effects section, including studio-quality reverbs, delays, and modulation effects, the OB-6 Desktop enhances its sonic capabilities. The OB-6 Desktop also includes a full-featured arpeggiator and sequencer for dynamic and evolving performances. Its MIDI and USB connectivity ensures seamless integration with any modern studio setup, offering a perfect blend of vintage sound and contemporary functionality.

official_description: The Trigon-6 Desktop Module delivers the same unmistakable sound as its keyboard counterpart, boasting six voices of pure analog warmth and punch. Its discrete signal path, inspired by the legendary Prophet-5, provides a rich and complex sonic palette suitable for a wide range of musical styles. From searing leads and lush pads to deep basses and evolving textures, the Trigon-6 is a versatile tool for sound design and performance.
